workspace.text:
Hi Brad! I've read Priya and Marcus's calendars. Here are their overlapping free slots (both available):

- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:30-16:00
- Thursday: 9:00-9:30, 15:30-16:00
- Friday: 11:00-12:00, 14:30-15:00

Could you check Elena and David's calendars and let me know which of these slots work for them? Or suggest other times that work for all four.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison! I've checked Elena and David's calendars. Unfortunately, NONE of the slots you provided for Priya & Marcus work because Elena and/or David are busy during all of them.

However, I found the following times when BOTH Elena and David are free (need 30 min slot):
- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00 or 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

Could you check if Priya and Marcus are free during any of these slots? If so, let me know which one(s) work for all four and we can proceed with booking.
